backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining services, queues, feedback, user profiles, and access‑controlled operations such as creating services, joining queues, and managing profiles.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to affected files, components, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the Smart Queue system.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based stylesheet defining color tokens, theme variables, and dark mode styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that loads the React application into the root DOM element.
frontend/LOCAL_STORAGE_MODE.md: Documentation explaining Local Storage Mode, including how to enable it, storage schema, and data model conventions.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app setup configuring routes, authentication, profile gating, theming, and layout rendering.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI screen shown when a user without admin rights attempts to access restricted areas.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthGate.ts: Authentication wrapper that handles identity initialization, login flow, and gating access to the app.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Login/logout button handling Internet Identity authentication and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Dialog for entering and saving a user's name using a mutation hook with validation and toasts.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main layout with header, navigation, storage settings sheet, and login controls, responsive for mobile and desktop.
frontend/src/components/localStorageMode: UI to enable or disable local storage mode and reset stored data with warnings and toasts.
frontend/src/features/admin/AdminPage.ts: Admin dashboard for viewing services, managing queue entries, marking no‑shows, serving next, and viewing feedback.
frontend/src/features/feedback/FeedbackP: Feedback form allowing users to select a service, rate it, submit comments, and view submission success messages.
frontend/src/features/localStorageMode/u: Hook managing the local storage mode flag with persistence and toggle helpers.
frontend/src/features/queue/QueuePage.ts: Queue interface letting users select a service, join or leave queues, and view real‑time queue position and tokens.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and invalidates dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user profiles, services, and queue operations, supporting both backend and localStorage modes.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining theme variables, light/dark modes, and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and mounts it to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the Smart Queue landing page with hero content, features, and a how‑it‑works section using styled UI components.
frontend/src/utils/sqfmLocalStorage.ts: Implements versioned localStorage utilities for queue, feedback, and service data with safe read/write and live update events.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading URL parameters (including hash routing), storing/retrieving them in sessionStorage, and syncing URL parameters to session state.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining dark mode, content paths, custom colors, typography, animations, and plugin integrations.
project_state.json: Tracks the project’s state, requirements, features, and architecture notes for a client‑side queue and feedback system using localStorage.
